name: Aldeanueva de San Bartolomé (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over blue with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of Aldeanueva de San Bartolomé (a tree, a castle and a flower).
history: Municipal flag of Aldeanueva de San Bartolomé; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
Aldeanueva de San Bartolomé arms — tree on yellow, castle on white and a flower on green
